name: salary-kkukku
description: A Korean macOS widget that estimates earnings in real time from a monthly salary and work schedule.

interface.longDescription: A Korean-language macOS widget that estimates this month's accumulated earnings in real time from a monthly salary, selected workdays, and working hours. Estimates are informational only and do not include holidays, breaks, taxes, or payroll adjustments.
defaultPrompt: Salary Kkukku의 월급과 근무 일정을 설정해줘.

prompts: Salary Kkukku의 월급과 근무 일정을 설정해줘.
review.commerce_description: Salary Kkukku is free and does not sell products, process payments, or offer paid features.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Salary Kkukku with real-time monthly earnings estimates and editable work schedules.

ko-KR.subtitle: 실시간 월급 카운터 위젯
ko-KR.description: 월급과 근무 요일·시간을 기준으로 이번 달 예상 누적 수입을 초 단위로 보여주는 macOS 꾸꾸 위젯입니다. 공휴일, 휴게시간, 세금 및 실제 급여 조정은 반영하지 않는 참고용 추정치입니다.
